description: Review added UI-code lines and propose deterministic DESIGN.md token substitutions without writing files. The returned unified patch applies on top of the reviewed diff's post-image; applying it is an explicit, separate step by the caller. Re-verifies the hypothetical polished lines and leaves judgment-heavy findings in manual.

design_md.description: Inline DESIGN.md content. Overrides project file lookup when supplied.

diff.description: Unified diff to review and polish (maximum 400KB).

project.description: Project directory used to resolve DESIGN.md and match decision scopes. Omit when design_md is supplied and no project hint is needed.

name: polish_diff
